decisions: The core has no terminal, provider SDK, or Bun-specific imports.
Observed source and intended component boundaries remain separate graphs.
One permission gate governs every executor; YOLO is the default.
Graphics, indexing, navigation and export are local operations with no model calls.
The CLI owns descriptor-rooted filesystem capabilities and mandatory native subprocess isolation; portable packages receive filesystem contracts through core.
Untrusted subprocesses work on bounded private snapshots; only the host reconciles authorized changes into the pinned workspace.
